White Breeze is the scent of pure air and light — clean, fresh and effortlessly elegant. A fragrance that feels as natural as breathing in crisp morning air.

Opening with bright Citrus and Bergamot lifted by Sicilian Orange, White Breeze reveals a luminous heart of Frankincense before settling into a clean, airy finish.
